blurb: Western European paintings from the 1200s to 1900, free to see on Trafalgar Square.

facts.t: Parliament bought 38 paintings from the banker John Julius Angerstein in 1824 and showed them in his house on Pall Mall. The building on Trafalgar Square opened in 1838.
Van Gogh painted sunflowers in Arles in August 1888 to decorate the room for Gauguin. The National Gallery's version is one of the four he made that month.
